portfolio:brief.summary: Trim IREN into its Anthropic-deal pop to rebuild your thin cash, then let the AI core keep compounding.
insights: Roughly 60% of your money sits in AI chips and the gear that powers them.
Cash is very thin — under 6% of the book versus your 16% goal.
IREN is down 35% and remains your single riskiest holding.
actions: Trim $400 IREN near $41; move proceeds to cash.
Buy $150 NVDA near $191 using the trim cash.
Add $150 AVGO on any further dip below here.
risks: AI-chip jitters (DeepSeek's own chip, Nvidia's 2028 system delay) could pressure the whole book — NVDA closing under $190 confirms it.
IREN's Anthropic bid is speculation, not a signed deal; a 'no' could drop it hard from $41.
